Maria: Hey team — quick coordination for the Customer Mastery session pods next week. Idea is to run 3 parallel 45m hands-on pods (EMEA / US / APAC-friendly times) for onboarding + renewal-risk customers. Can folks pick leads and caps?
Alex: I can lead the US pod. prefer morning PST. happy to pair with an SE. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll take EMEA pod but need it after 09:00 GMT. we should cap at 6 customers per pod.
Dan: APAC works for me, 10:30 SGT start ok. I'll pull the pre-read and sample prompts into a single doc.
Maria: thanks. two asks: 1) flag any renewal-risk accounts to prioritize, 2) we should include a short rollout checklist in the session.
Jordan: renewal-risk list attached in the sheet (link: https://bit.ly/rw-risk-list). i'd recommend we leave one slot per pod for an exec sponsor callout.
Priya: agreed on exec slot. also propose this agenda: 1) 10m quick config review, 2) 20m guided prompts + live debugging, 3) 10m Q&A, 4) 5m next steps.
Alex: that agenda looks good. can we make a short template for the guided debugging step? maybe a 3-bullet template: symptoms, reproducer, ideal output.
Dan: added a tiny template in the doc: `symptoms | example prompt | expected token ranges` — works for live triage.
Maria: perfect. capacity code for the signup form: ```capacity_per_pod=6; exec_slot=1; duration_mins=45``` please copy into the form builder.
calendar-bot: Event draft created: "Customer Mastery — US pod" — 2026-03-25 09:00 PST — 6 seats. RSVP link: https://cal.redwood.ai/e/abcd1234
Alex: put me as host on the US event. I'll add a quick recording consent line to the invite.
Priya: i can host EMEA and will add timezone-friendly repeat.
Maria: final check — Dan, can you own the pre-read + link in the invites by EOD today?
Dan: yes, will upload doc and add links by 5pm PT.
Maria: awesome — i'll follow up w/ an internal run-through Thur morning. pls add any blockers here. :rocket:
